flags: minor: 'registered' in 1900 is loose (few states registered cars then); ~8,000 cars is the standard cited figure, so acceptable
S036-01.notes: Nascent = just beginning; supported by few cars and handmade production. Obsolete contradicts 'still'; regulated/consolidated unsupported (small workshops argue against consolidated).

S036-02.notes: Old car, lunch with juniors, crediting colleagues = modest/unassuming; 'Although' contrast with fame fits. Extravagant/ambitious contradict; indecisive irrelevant.

S036-03.notes: Sentence 2 = microscope finding of hooks catching loops, the basis of Velcro. B=sentence 3, C=sentence 1, D=sentence 4. Facts (1941, Swiss, 1950s patent) accurate.

S036-04.notes: Wish for new coat gives way to appreciation after imagining sister mending it; wears it all day. A is initial feeling only; B and D unsupported.

S036-05.notes: Only D compares near vs far showing rising survival. A and C give single values; B is true but gives no comparison to farther seedlings.

flags: minor: key is the only hedged choice ('may be linked'), a mild cue
S036-06.notes: Self-control correlated with learning -> link between delay capacity and learning. C overgeneralizes, D reverses causality/valence, A contradicts preference. Matches Schnell et al. 2021 cuttlefish study.

S036-07.notes: Guilty look tracked scolding, not actual eating. B contradicts the finding; C, D unsupported. Horowitz 2009 design described accurately.

S036-08.notes: C names the Golden Records, their vehicle/date, contents, and purpose — a full introduction. A assumes familiarity ('The records'); B is about spacecraft; D omits name and contents. Facts (1977, 55 languages, 115 images) accurate.

S036-09.notes: Parallel series after 'can': climb, open, carry.

S036-10.notes: Possessive relative pronoun before 'team'. who's = who is ungrammatical; who/whom leave 'team first detected' ungrammatical.
